notes:
'Admin' is read as Abraham George's role; Aaron Le's role (agent) is not asked to change and is not tested.
This policy has no rule on removing a departing employee from all groups, and the request replaces Kurt Fritz only in Contact Center L2, so his other memberships (Vendor Case Liaison, Proactive Case Monitoring_3, Customer Health Monitoring_4) are not tested either way.
The check on both additions to Contact Center L2 is a conjunction of the two membership requirements and is carried by both, one per user.
The location's plot number and street are not given and are not tested.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay holding Aaron Zimmerman's (user 598) three memberships outside Contact Center L2 at their seed count, present in one pass only; kept because he is the other user named Aaron and already sits in Contact Center L2, so a loose reading of 'Aaron ... focusing solely on Contact Center L2' would sweep his memberships in, and the request names Aaron Le only.
